$comment: Agent-facing capability index. No single agents.json schema has won yet, so this document is deliberately plain: each entry is an interface an agent can use right now, described the way the site itself would describe it. The MCP server card lives at /.well-known/mcp.json.
name: knowbase
description: Verified, source-backed answers to concrete engineering failures. Machine-first: every entry ships as JSON, Markdown and plain text alongside HTML, and the lookup answers 'we do not cover this' rather than returning a near miss.

interfaces.purpose: Look up entries from an error message, error code, or pasted stack trace. Returns match=strong|partial|none with root causes and exclusions inlined.
Narrow a matched entry to the one root cause your observed discriminator results identify.
Report whether the applied fix held, so the entry can be re-verified.
The same three calls as MCP tools: knowbase_lookup, knowbase_diagnose, knowbase_report_outcome.
Index of every entry, llmstxt.org format. /llms-full.txt carries the whole corpus in one fetch.
